Task: Streaming Speech-to-Text

Write code that streams audio chunks from an async source using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Amazon Transcribe Streaming:
  Service: Amazon Transcribe Streaming
  SDK: amazon-transcribe / boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: start_stream_transcription
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transcribe/latest/dg/streaming.html

Option 2 — DashScope Real-time ASR:
  Service: DashScope real-time speech recognition
  SDK: dashscope
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: RecognitionCallback, streaming call
  Setup hints: DASHSCOPE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/real-time-speech-recognition

Option 3 — Azure Speech Streaming:
  Service: Azure AI Speech streaming
  SDK: azure-cognitiveservices-speech
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: start_continuous_recognition, recognized
  Setup hints: AZURE_SPEECH_KEY, AZURE_SPEECH_REGION
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/speech-service/how-to-recognize-speech

Option 4 — Watson STT WebSocket:
  Service: Watson Speech to Text WebSocket
  SDK: ibm-watson
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: recognize_using_websocket
  Setup hints: IBM_STT_APIKEY, IBM_STT_URL
  Official docs: https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/speech-to-text?topic=speech-to-text-websockets

Option 5 — Deepgram:
  Service: Deepgram Streaming API
  SDK: deepgram-sdk
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: listen.websocket, transcribe
  Setup hints: DEEPGRAM_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://developers.deepgram.com/docs/lower-level-websockets

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

output_text:
import asyncio
import os
from collections import deque
from typing import AsyncGenerator, Deque, Callable, Awaitable

from deepgram_sdk import DeepgramClient, DeepgramClientOptions, LiveTranscriptionEvents


class AudioStreamer:
    def __init__(self):
        # DeepgramClient automatically picks up DEEPGRAM_API_KEY from environment variables
        self.deepgram_client = DeepgramClient(os.getenv("DEEPGRAM_API_KEY"))
        self.audio_queue: Deque[bytes] = deque()
        self.producer_finished = asyncio.Event()

    async def _audio_chunk_producer(self, async_audio_source: AsyncGenerator[bytes, None]):
        """Consumes audio from an async source and puts it into the queue."""
        try:
            async for chunk in async_audio_source:
                self.audio_queue.append(chunk)
        except Exception as e:
            # Log or handle potential errors from the audio source
            print(f"Error in audio chunk producer: {e}")
        finally:
            self.producer_finished.set()  # Signal that the source has finished sending audio

    async def _audio_chunk_generator(self) -> AsyncGenerator[bytes, None]:
        """Yields audio chunks from the queue for Deepgram."""
        while True:
            if self.audio_queue:
                yield self.audio_queue.popleft()
            elif self.producer_finished.is_set() and not self.audio_queue:
                # Producer has finished and queue is empty, so we are done
                break
            else:
                # Queue is empty, but producer might still be active. Wait a bit.
                await asyncio.sleep(0.01)  # Small sleep to prevent busy-waiting

    async def stream_audio_to_text(
        self,
        async_audio_source: AsyncGenerator[bytes, None],
        on_transcription_received: Callable[[str], Awaitable[None]] = None
    ):
        """
        Streams audio chunks from an async source to Deepgram and processes transcriptions.

        Args:
            async_audio_source: An async generator that yields audio byte chunks.
            on_transcription_received: An optional async callback function to handle
                                       each received transcription string.
        """
        # Reset state for a new stream
        self.audio_queue.clear()
        self.producer_finished.clear()

        # Start the producer task in the background
        producer_task = asyncio.create_task(self._audio_chunk_producer(async_audio_source))

        dg_connection = self.deepgram_client.listen.websocket.v("1")

        # Define the message handler to easily access on_transcription_received
        async def _on_message(_, result, **kwargs):
            if result.type == LiveTranscriptionEvents.Transcript:
                transcript = result.channel.alternatives[0].transcript
                if transcript and on_transcription_received:
                    await on_transcription_received(transcript)

        dg_connection.on(LiveTranscriptionEvents.Transcript, _on_message)

        try:
            # Start the Deepgram connection with transcription options
            # Using 'nova-2' model for better accuracy
            await dg_connection.start(options={"model": "nova-2", "language": "en-US"})

            # Send audio from the generator
            await dg_connection.send(self._audio_chunk_generator())

            # Wait for the producer to finish and then ensure all audio is sent and processed
            await producer_task
            # After all audio is sent, signal Deepgram to close the stream.
            await dg_connection.finish()

        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Error during Deepgram streaming: {e}")
        finally:
            # Ensure the Deepgram connection is closed if it's still listening
            if dg_connection.is_listening:
                await dg_connection.finish()
            # Ensure producer task is properly managed in case of an early exit
            if not producer_task.done():
                producer_task.cancel()
            await asyncio.gather(producer_task, return_exceptions=True)  # Wait for it to clean up gracefully
